notes: PvE: the host can now start alone, and somebody who joins a PvE room while its match is running takes a free seat and joins 1P's team at once (everybody's game pauses for a second or two as they come in). A PvE room that is running shows it can be joined. Fixed: a fresh install could not join a PvE room before its first match; a player leaving a PvE match was sometimes not taken out of the game; a spectator joining a running match could see a slightly different game. Everybody needs this version to play PvE together.
